text:
Priya (Product): Quick heads-up — we're going to consolidate incoming customer signals into a single prio_score to drive roadmap slices. Need a cross-team crosswalk so we don't unintentionally ship blockers. Can folks call out hard requirements we should encode? :eyes:
Marcus (Eng-runtime): +1. Need to know which thresholds imply runtime changes (model variant pinning, kv-cache tweaks, batching configs). Example: prio_score >= 8 -> pin to low-latency variant and prewarm.
Ava (Infra): From infra side, call out expected qps, burst windows, and whether Dedicated reservation is required. We can pre-allocate slots if you give a rollout window.
Liam (Security): Security questions: any PII attachments, need for HSM/KMS, or contract/legal escalations? High-security customers will need an expedited threat review (2–3 weeks).
Zoe (Eng): Also need clear acceptance criteria for each prio band. E.g. band 7+ = perf targets (p95 < 200ms), integration tests, and smoke on staging before canary.
Raj (PM): Proposal: map signals -> bands. Quick draft: revenue impact, active-usage, legal exposure, data-sensitivity, product-fit. Score 0-10, then bands 0-3 (low), 4-6 (medium), 7-10 (high). High band triggers: Dedicated capacity opt-in, security review, SLAs. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Marcus (Eng-runtime): That works. For high band we'll need runtime changes: reserve burst GPUs, disable large-batch optimizer for latency-critical requests, and set up a canary route to fallback to hosted model if dedicated fails. Can we get expected percent of traffic for high band?
Priya (Product): Good call. For initial cohort assume 5–10% traffic at peak per customer for high band. We'll update the PR with customer list and expected windows.
Ava (Infra): If it's 5–10% per high customer, we should tag those deployments and prewarm. I can own a simple reservation plan. Need a list of customers + peak windows by EOD Friday.
Liam (Security): Also: if customers require KMS/HSM, that adds ~1 week to onboarding for provisioning and audits. Flag any with regulatory requirements now.
Zoe (Eng): On rollout sequencing: suggest pilot with 1 customer (high band) -> iterate on prewarm + routing -> then 3 more. Keep canary window 6 hours with rollback triggers defined.
Raj (PM): I'll synthesize into a short spec and include a dependency matrix: signal -> band -> infra action -> runtime changes -> security gate -> launch gate. Will post PR and request reviews from @Marcus, @Ava, @Liam, @Zoe by tomorrow noon.
Priya (Product): Awesome. Meeting to finalize? 30m tomorrow 11:00am PT. If that works, I'll add a quick agenda: 1) confirm scoring rubric 2) map top 6 customers to bands 3) surface resource gaps 4) sign-off owners.
Marcus (Eng-runtime): 11:00 works. I'll bring perf numbers and a minimal checklist for runtime changes.
Ava (Infra): I'll prepare reservation plan and cost estimates.
Liam (Security): I'll list out review steps and estimated timelines per band.
Zoe (Eng): I'll draft the acceptance tests and rollback triggers.
Raj (PM): Filing the PR now, will link here.
deploy-bot: Scheduled meeting created: product/crosswalk-prio-signal • Tomorrow 11:00am PT • Zoom link in calendar.
Priya (Product): Thanks all. If anyone discovers an absolute blocker (legal, infra, or security), ping me directly so we can escalate. :pray:
